classes.name: TranslationMemory
classes.description: Represents a translation memory stored in a file, with methods to load, retrieve, add, and save translation entries.

methods.name: LoadTranslationMemory
methods.description: Loads translation entries from a specified JSON lines file into a TranslationMemory object.

methods.name: TranslationMemory.Get
methods.description: Retrieves a translated entry by cache key if available and valid.

methods.name: TranslationMemory.Put
methods.description: Adds or updates a translation entry in the memory.

methods.name: TranslationMemory.Save
methods.description: Saves the current translation memory entries back to the file, sorted by key.
